method: Read every historical patch and PR metadata, trace surviving implementation or replacement at the baseline, then reproduce concrete defects. Review dispositions do not prove the absence of other defects.

findings.title: Paint, fill and erase force upper-layer pixels opaque
findings.trigger: New transparent upper layer, red Pencil at 50% opacity or Fill with mask alpha128, then Eraser.
findings.observed: Paint/Fill produces [128,0,0,255], expected [255,0,0,128]; composite dark red instead of pink. Eraser writes opaque color instead of revealing lower layer.
findings.impact: Changes soft edges and output pixels; layer erasing cannot reveal lower artwork.
findings.fix: Destination-alpha-aware source-over paint/fill and layer-aware destination-out eraser. Preserve selected Background color from PR729 and history/cache/selection behavior.
acceptance: Fractional paint/fill onto transparent and semitransparent layers retain correct RGBA/composite.
Upper eraser reveals lower layer; Background honors PR729 chosen color.
Undo/Redo, preview and Apply retain the same pixel result.

findings.title: Merge Down changes artwork on transparent lower layer
findings.trigger: White Background, transparent lower layer, opaque red upper at50% layer opacity; Merge Down.
findings.impact: Merge changes the image that is subsequently applied and output.
findings.fix: Merge normal layers with straight RGBA and both effective opacities. Bake non-normal combinations against their current backdrop into a normal merged layer, retaining effective alpha and visibility.
acceptance: Composite equivalence before/after normal merges over several lower backgrounds.
Partial pixel alpha, non-unit upper/lower opacity, hidden layers and supported blend cases.
Preserve lower identity and documented history/cache invalidation.

findings.title: Off-image rectangle marquee selects unrelated pixels
findings.trigger: 10x10 image; rectangle x=-20,y=1,width=5,height=3 wholly left of image.
findings.observed: 85 pixels selected, indices10..94; expected0. Negative TypedArray.fill end wraps from buffer end.
findings.impact: Later selection edits can modify most of image after a gutter drag.
findings.fix: Intersect both pixel-center spans with image bounds and return empty before fill for no overlap.
acceptance: Fully outside each edge selects0.
Partial/fractional rectangles match exact intersecting pixel centers.
Pointer completion plus existing selection boolean modes remain correct.

findings.title: Editor Crop fabricates wrong pixels and physical bounds outside image
findings.trigger: 10x10 image; crop x12,y1,w3,h3 outside, or x-2,y1,w5,h3 partially left.
findings.observed: Outside crop becomes1x3 at physical x12..13; partial-left becomes5x3 instead of3x3. Linear copy may read another source row.
findings.impact: Wrong content, extent and placement applied to workspace.
findings.fix: Compute one correct rectangle intersection before pixel copy; no overlap is no-op, never force fabricated1px.
acceptance: No-overlap crops preserve content/revision/history/bounds.
Partial/fractional/repeated crops use exact pixels and physical mapping.
All layers, pending Apply and Revert remain consistent.

findings.title: Image Size moves and stretches cropped artwork
findings.trigger: 10px/10mm image, crop x/y2..5 =>3x3px, resize to2x2px.
findings.observed: Bounds2..5 become1.6666667..5; rounded base6 and offset1 expand3mm to3.333mm and move left/down.
findings.impact: Changing pixel density changes engraving size/alignment contrary to UI promise.
findings.fix: Keep continuous physical pixel size and crop offsets independent of rounded Revert-base dimensions. Apply restores the original physical bounds after Revert as well as preserving cropped bounds after Image Size.
acceptance: Odd/noninteger/repeated/anisotropic Image Size after crop preserves exact bounds.
Canvas Size padding and later crops consistent.
Revert, source transforms and scene Apply preserve intended geometry.
Crop, Apply, Revert and Apply restores original scene bounds; Apply of a resized crop preserves its physical extent.

findings.title: Odd-size downsampling drops trailing row and column
findings.trigger: 5x5 white source with black final row and column, downsample2x2.
findings.observed: All9 black edge pixels disappear; output entirelywhite. floor-based halve never reads index4.
findings.impact: Resizing loses border detail and biases artwork toward top-left, possibly over multiple stages.
findings.fix: Cover entire source domain including odd trailing samples with appropriate alpha-aware filtering at each reduction.
acceptance: 5x5->2x2 border/corner contribution retained.
Mirror/rotation-equivalent fixtures stay equivalent.
Flat fields, large odd reductions and transparent edges retain correct target dimensions.

findings.title: CNC profile leads can cross and cut a neighboring kept part
findings.trigger: Two disjoint outside-profile contours with an accepted line lead whose endpoints lie outside the neighboring contour but whose segment crosses it. The probe uses a persisted supported profileLead shape=line, radiusMm=10 setting and default 3.175mm cutter.
findings.observed: cncGroupForLayer emits a path3d lead at Z=-1 from (38.413,60.0005) to (48.413,60.0005), through an actual kept 3x3mm sibling at X41.913..44.913,Y58.5005..61.5005. G-code contains G1 X48.413 Y60.001 Z-1.000 F1000 after the waste-side plunge.
findings.impact: Deterministic unintended cutting of a neighboring part. This is emitted-byte evidence, not hardware qualification.
findings.fix: Check complete lead-in/out segments against existing kept-part geometry, including sibling and self-side crossings as applicable. Reuse the existing legacy-plunge fallback without adding an operational refusal or new policy gate.
acceptance: Line crossing with all endpoints outside falls back.
Arc chord crossing with outside endpoints falls back.
Clear leads retain geometry and emitted bytes.
Full compiler/emitter regression, repeated depth, hole/rough-finish identity, and physical origin cases remain correct.

findings.title: Paint Bucket overwrites pixels outside the active selection
findings.trigger: Open a uniform image, select a small rectangle, and click Paint Bucket inside it.
findings.observed: An 8x1 white document with only its first 2 pixels selected becomes [0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0] after black bucket fill.
findings.impact: The tool destroys edits outside the operator-selected area; one undo can recover the action.
findings.fix: Intersect the wand region with the active selection, preserving feather alpha, then derive history/dirty bounds from the effective mask. Preserve full-region behavior with no active selection.
acceptance: Hard selection limits paint.
Feather alpha controls blended paint.
Clicks outside the selection do not paint unselected pixels.
Multilayer sampling and one-step undo/redo remain correct.

findings.title: Single-layer Clone Stamp smears its own new pixels
findings.trigger: On an ordinary one-layer image, clone along a stroke whose destination overlaps its source.
findings.observed: The 8x1 ramp [20,40,60,80,100,120,140,160], cloned rightward with offset(-1,0), becomes all 20.
findings.impact: Normal overlapping cloning collapses detail into a repeated color instead of copying the chosen source.
findings.fix: Ensure the clone source is independent of its destination before mutation. Copy when the composite aliases the destination; avoid copying a composite that is already independent.
acceptance: Overlapping strokes in both directions use pre-stroke pixels.
One-layer and multilayer paths agree.
Selection, opacity, aligned offset, and undo/redo remain correct.

findings.title: Image Studio rough engrave time ignores physical object scale
findings.trigger: Resize a raster using object scale, then inspect its Image Studio Ink & Time readout.
findings.observed: A fully black 10x10 mm image at 60 mm/min, 1 line/mm, 1 pass reads 100 seconds both at scale1x1 and scale2x3.
findings.impact: Potentially large misleading advisory duration. Compiled output and authoritative Job Review timing are not changed by this helper.
findings.fix: Use physical raster dimensions after absolute object scale for the estimate, following the actual scan-axis contract. Keep ink coverage independent of physical size.
acceptance: Uniform and nonuniform scale change duration appropriately.
Negative mirror scales retain positive duration.
Cropped document size and per-object settings retain the current intended estimate model.

findings.title: Dependency override breaks brace-pattern enumeration in ESLint
findings.trigger: Run the existing ESLint CLI with a normal brace pattern: node node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js 'src/ui/image-editor/editor-session{,-fill}.ts'.
findings.observed: ESLint9.39.4 globSearch calls minimatch3.1.5 and throws TypeError: expand is not a function before linting. Direct frozen-lockfile probes also fail in minimatch5.1.9 and9.0.9; minimatch10.2.5 succeeds.
findings.impact: Developer-tool glob functionality is broken. Ordinary single-file lint was run successfully; this does not claim ordinary pnpm lint or every packaging path is broken.
findings.fix: Pin compatible patched brace-expansion lines 1.1.18, 2.1.4, 3.0.6 and 5.0.9 by affected version range; retain the existing coverage-specific glob/minimatch edge. Test actual installed ESLint and coverage-glob brace expansion.
acceptance: Frozen-lockfile install succeeds.
Brace matching works through every remaining minimatch major.
Actual ESLint brace-pattern command succeeds.
Coverage glob contract and release packaging metadata tests pass.
Dependency audit/closure evidence explains the retained security posture.

findings.title: A whole-perimeter tab window cuts the full contour at cutting depth
findings.trigger: 8 mm square, on-path, default 3.175 mm tool, depth6/tabHeight2, one tabWidth28.825 (window32 exactly equals perimeter) or tabWidth30 (oversized); within the current width field range.
findings.observed: Both actual compiler/emitter cases contain five points at Z-6 instead of preserving Z-4 over the whole contour. Direct helper exact/oversized probes also fail.
findings.impact: Emitted output cuts through intended holding material.
findings.fix: Represent full coverage before normalizing ends, after confirming at least one valid center exists.
acceptance: Equal/oversized windows with automatic/manual centers never cut below tab top.
Explicitly empty manual centers create no tabs.
Assert actual compile and emitted G-code on the normal-size/default-tool example.

findings.title: A tab ending at the seam descends diagonally through its final span
findings.trigger: 10 mm square, depth6/tabHeight2, total window4 centered at manual pathT .95. Default-tool compile uses width .825.
findings.observed: Helper tail moves (0,4,-4) directly to (0,0,-6). Actual compiled/manual-anchor output reproduces diagonal descent, ending at machine (0,400,-6).
findings.impact: The rectangular tab tapers to full cutting depth at the seam.
findings.fix: Close at last-span Z, then change height vertically at the seam.
acceptance: Windows ending/beginning/wrapping at seam preserve rectangular walls.
Actual compile/emitter produces no simultaneous XY/Z change through a rectangular tab wall.

findings.title: A larger pocket suppresses a smaller pocket's final core clearing
findings.trigger: 8.175 mm square and separate 25 mm square in one imported SVG path/pocket layer, 3.175 mm tool, 85% stepover.
findings.observed: Small alone: 2 paths, nearest centerline .0015 mm from center. Together: 7 paths, nearest 2.4995 mm > radius1.5875. Actual compile is identical; offsetFailed/passLimited false.
findings.impact: Full-depth material remains at the smaller center; at least .912 mm radial gap from cutter sweep.
findings.fix: Preserve the central pass for each independently owned region and add local core boundaries found by subtracting actual cutter sweep from the initial tool-center region. Keep islands, regular ring order, requested spacing and geometry-failure warnings.
acceptance: Adding larger disconnected geometry does not reduce smaller pocket coverage.
Same/different source objects, island holes, and narrow-neck component splits preserve intended cutter-sweep coverage.
Verify compiled/emitted paths, not only count.

findings.title: Ordinary G0/G1/G2/G3 motion fails to cancel drilling
findings.trigger: G21 G90; G0 Z5; G81 X10 Y10 Z-3 R1 F200; G0 X30; M2 (separate lines).
findings.observed: G0 X30 draws another drill plunge/retract without unsupported/skipped warning.
findings.impact: Inspector invents holes and distorts geometry, timing, and health.
findings.fix: Cancel cycle on supported group-1 motion changes; retain explicit no-motion G80 semantics.
acceptance: Ordinary motion after each supported cycle draws only its requested move.
Cover arbitrary word order and modal-only transition lines.

findings.title: Incremental cycle R/Z are treated as absolute coordinates
findings.observed: Inspector R1.8/bottom-.6; correct documented example R4.8/bottom4.2. No qualification emitted.
findings.impact: Drilling geometry is displaced several millimeters while appearing understood.
findings.fix: Resolve cycle-specific incremental R and bottom, preserving correct sticky state.
acceptance: Documented example plus subsequent modal holes.
Inch units and G90/G91/re-entry transitions.

findings.title: G99 invents high traverse and G98 can retract below R
findings.trigger: Two G99 holes starting Z5/R1; separate G98 hole starting Z0/R1.
findings.observed: Second G99 hole lifts to old Z5 before XY; G98 returns below R to Z0. No qualification emitted.
findings.impact: Inspector hides actual low traverse and misstates return clearance.
findings.fix: Preliminary clearance depends on current Z and R; G98 returns to max(oldZ,R), G99 to R.
acceptance: Exact segment heights for subsequent G99 holes and G98 initial Z above/below R.
Verify movement order and timing.

findings.title: G82 loses bottom dwell from timing/playback
findings.trigger: G82 P2 at one hole followed by a second bare X hole in the same cycle.
findings.observed: No dwell events; dwellSeconds=0 for both holes.
findings.impact: Readout undercounts cycle time and playback retracts immediately.
findings.fix: Retain cycle P and insert dwell at each bottom before retract, within same-line motion timing.
acceptance: Two P2 holes contribute 4 seconds at their bottoms.
Changed P replaces duration; G81 does not inherit dwell.

findings.title: Dense curves lose all direction arrows
findings.trigger: 20 mm diameter circle represented by 20 versus 200 G1 edges.
findings.observed: Coarse:20 arrows; dense:62.8293 mm cutting and zero arrows.
findings.impact: Direction review disappears on finely sampled CNC traces.
findings.fix: Sample continuous cut arc-length across small edges independently of subdivision.
acceptance: Dense/coarse same curve both show bounded useful arrows.
Long and mixed short/long paths distribute arrows.

findings.title: Rapid plunges receive cutting-only arrows
findings.observed: Zero cutting distance and one rapid segment still produce one cut arrow.
findings.impact: Overlay labels non-cutting travel as cutting direction.
findings.fix: Exclude rapid motion before cut/plunge qualification.
acceptance: Rapid-only programs produce zero arrows.
Feed plunges retain intended eligibility.

findings.title: Indexed nearest-entry search skips the preferred equal-distance candidate
findings.trigger: A candidate lies exactly on the unsearched grid boundary, tied with a scanned later segment or reverse direction.
findings.observed: The <= safe-radius shortcut returns before checking an equal-distance candidate preferred by the linear ordering contract.
findings.impact: Changes deterministic travel ordering and forward-direction tie behavior.
findings.fix: Use a strict safe-radius interior check so boundary ties are fully resolved.
acceptance: Both earlier-segment and forward-direction ties match an independent linear oracle; related travel/optimizer tests pass.
